verdict.rationale: The pack lists features that suggest background automation: Monitors (continuous checks that alert), Watchdog (automated anomaly detection), Kubernetes Autoscaling, and Bits AI (an AI assistant). But these items are titles only, with no content showing a user can build custom autonomous automations or agent-driven background tasks. missing for 10: documented workflow-automation builder, evidence that Bits AI runs autonomous background tasks, details on triggers/actions/remediation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
